evidence.ACL: Complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance.
evidence.MCL: Grade II ligamentous sprain (partial tear) of the medial collateral ligament, at mid substance (deep and superficial fibers).
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Buckethandle tear of the medial meniscus.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Longitudinal vertical oblique tear at the body and posterior horn of the lateral meniscus.
evidence.Medial OA: There is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury.
evidence.Lateral OA: The lateral compartment, there is longitudinal vertical oblique tear at the body and posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. There is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury.
evidence.PF OA: The patellofemoral joint, the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion.
evidence.Effusion: Minimal amount of right knee effusion is present.
evidence.Contusion: There is no fracture or bone contusion.
evidence.Fracture: There is no fracture or bone contusion.
